reviews.title: A good choice for reliability and performance
reviews.comment: So far, so good. Performance is solid and Western Digital enjoys a good reputation for reliability and service life.
reviews.author: Jose L. Trasancos

reviews.title: Functions well on a PC
reviews.comment: Can't go wrong with a WD drive, especially when it's at a bargain price. It's fast with plenty of storage and functions well for daily tasks in a PC.
reviews.author: PGI

reviews.title: Very nice upgrade that will extend the life of my laptop.
reviews.comment: This SSD has made a noticeable difference in the speed of most things on my laptop. It was a bit of a circus to get it installed, formatted, and cloned but with the help of Acronis software it all worked in the end. My Dell 7506 2n1 laptop came with a 256GB Gen3 SSD in October of 2021 and was getting filled up so I needed to do something, and this was cheaper than a new laptop. I don't use it for games so raw speed was not a primary goal.
reviews.author: K. Kindt

reviews.title: very fast - not much heat
reviews.comment: Put in Macally dock for mac mini m4 Just as fast as internal ssd. Runs about 80 degrees F Every thing sits on top  of 1.5 " thick power transistor heat sink w/ fins. Works great
